name: chevron-down
description: A balanced downward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Mirrored 45-degree arms meet at 12,15.25, with endpoints at 5.5,8.75 and 18.5,8.75. A single continuous centerline avoids doubled joins. Native bounds are centered at 12,12. Regular visible margins are 4.65 horizontally and 7.9 vertically. Rounded caps and the rounded lower vertex use the shared 1.70 stroke. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Owner rejected the radius-1.50 curved-head experiment on2026-10-27. Return to the original straight-arm V head with round .85 caps and round stroke joins at Regular1.70. Do not reintroduce a broad centerline fillet. Owner requested a solid arrowhead for every Filled arrow on2026-10-27. Outline retains the open straight-arm V. Filled closes that same head into a solid triangular body, including the Regular1.70 round exterior at its three corners; shaft and tray geometry are retained. Corresponding tip, arm endpoints, native outer bounds and Regular1.70 weight remain aligned. This is a semantic solid-head exception to reproducing the open Outline interior. Owner approved this current pair on2026-10-27.

review.note: Owner approved both current styles: open straight-arm V head in Outline and solid triangular head in Filled, with aligned tips/endpoints, original shafts/trays and Regular1.70 reference.
